observations: prepare_manager_execution_task accepts root_task_id, passes it to manager.decide_vertical only when that callable accepts the parameter, and returns PreparedManagerHandoff with root_task_id stored; it does not call manager_bounded_handoff, prepared.commit, or persist a bounded handoff.

manager_triage accepts root_task_id and conditionally forwards it to runner.chat_reply_if_conversational; it returns a conversational reply or None and contains no manager_bounded_handoff invocation or bounded-handoff persistence step.

The same-file manager_bounded_handoff is a separate commit target: when needed it calls prepare_manager_execution_task with root_task_id, validates prepared.root_task_id against the supplied root_task_id, then under a pipeline lock obtains a division via _bounded_handoff_division or prepared.commit and invokes persist before marking completion.

No name_session parameter or explicit name_session=true supply appears in either tested function or in this same-file manager_bounded_handoff target, so this surface cannot establish the previously required name_session=true conjunction.

Therefore the exact selected front_door surface proves root_task_id carriage into prepared state and conversational triage, but neither manager_triage nor prepare_manager_execution_task itself commits the bounded handoff. Caller behavior outside this file was intentionally not inspected.
